title: Recruitment Requests
description: Hiring needs per team — HR Leader approves and assigns a recruiter to build the posting

empty.title: No requests yet
empty.description: There are no recruitment requests in your scope.
empty.descriptionAuthor: Create a request to raise a hiring need for your team.

form.salaryHint: Leave both empty if negotiable. HR Leader may send the request back to adjust this range.
form.reasonPlaceholder: e.g. Backfill, team growth, new project...
form.descriptionPlaceholder: Key skills and experience — the recruiter will write the JD from this.
form.requirementsPlaceholder:
One requirement per line, e.g.
Proficient in C# / ASP.NET MVC
Solid OOP, able to apply it in real projects
At least 3 months of hands-on experience
form.requirementsHint: Skills and criteria the candidate must meet. Each line becomes a bullet in the JD draft the recruiter receives.
form.departmentUnsetHint: Your account has no department yet, so you cannot file a request. Ask a Super Admin to assign one on the Users screen.
form.salaryNegotiableHint: Filed as negotiable — the HR Leader settles the figure when approving the offer.

detail.title: Request details
detail.pickOne: Select a request on the left to see its details.
detail.assignHint: Approval always includes assignment — only the assigned recruiter can build the posting.
detail.rejectReasonPlaceholder: e.g. Salary range exceeds the band for this level, please lower it...
detail.rejectReasonHint: At least 10 characters. The requester needs to know what to change.
detail.createJob: Build job posting from this request
detail.jobAlreadyCreated: This request already has a job posting.
detail.revokeHint: An approved request that has not become a job posting yet can still be edited or closed. Both actions revoke the approval and notify the people involved.
detail.revokeReasonPlaceholder: e.g. the team changed direction and needs a different role…
detail.reopenHint: The request goes back to pending so you can edit it, and the HR Leader must approve it again together with a recruiter assignment.
detail.closeHint: The request is closed for good and cannot become a job posting. File a new request if the need returns.
